description: Execute a payment with a one-time token. TWO CALLS: call it first WITHOUT `recheck` — nothing is charged and it hands you what the owner actually asked for, locked when the card was issued; look at the page again, then call it a second time with `recheck` to pay or to pause. Then Z-Zero opens a headless browser, injects the card (you NEVER see the PAN), clicks Pay, and watches for a REAL confirmation before reporting success. Returns a `status`: `confirmed` (order placed → token burned, receipt_id may hold a real order #), `declined` (merchant rejected → token kept for refund), `unconfirmed` (submitted but no confirmation seen → do NOT retry blindly, verify first), `not_submitted` (no Pay button → supply a submit_selector hint), or `no_fields`. ALWAYS pass actual_amount so overcharges are blocked and underspend refunded.

actual_amount.description: STRONGLY RECOMMENDED. The final total shown on the checkout page (incl. shipping + tax). Enables the overcharge block and the underspend refund — omit only if it is genuinely unreadable.

checkout_url.description: The full URL of the checkout/payment page

hints.description: Optional hints from get_merchant_hints — selectors and pre-steps to guide Playwright. Use when default selectors fail or for complex multi-step checkouts.

recheck.description: Your answer to the purpose check. Omit it on the first call — this tool will hand you the owner's locked criteria to read, then you call again with this.

decision.description: go = pay it. pause = something is off; nothing is charged, the card is not typed in, the money stays put and you tell your owner.

page_shows.description: What is ACTUALLY on the page in front of you right now — item, variant, quantity, final total. Describe it, do not summarise it as 'looks right'.

why.description: Required when you pause: what did not line up.

token.description: The temporary payment token from request_payment_token

name: execute_payment
title: Execute Payment (charges the card)
